docs.purpose: Returns the admin media rows with server display strings, sort keys and one short-lived signed preview URL per row.
docs.data_story: It reads media_assets (capped at media_list_page_max) and signs every object path in one call; a row it could not sign has signed_url null and the response counts them in meta.unsigned.
docs.under_126: A QUERY CONTRACT; the LIST surface binds its columns to this projection (FE-32 `contract` binding kind).

checks.why: guards.session must equal classifyRoute("/api/admin/media") → "admin" plus verifyAdminAuth on the first line of the GET handler; locked by src/tests/admin-media.security.test.ts.

errors.why: Success and failure both arrive in the { data, error, meta } envelope; withApiEnvelope converts any uncaught throw into the same shape with a sanitised code.

classes.ui: The page is not reachable without an admin session (requireAdminPage); a client call gets UNAUTHORIZED.
A non-session admin credential gets SESSION_REQUIRED; Storage refusing the session gets STORAGE_SESSION_REQUIRED.
Validation errors are shown by the form from content.
The persistent error toast from content; the request is logged.

emits.why: A read writes no ledger row; a signing failure logs one media_sign error per request.

offers.why: An admin endpoint renders no sponsored placement.

metering.why: Admin media operations are not metered; the admin preview ledger is deferred (Spec 114 §6 dated note 2026-11-09).
